import subprocess
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from handoff_demo.git_budget import approved_retry_limit


class HiddenTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reviewed_tag_not_the_newest_or_working_tree(self):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        def git(*args):
            subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", *args], cwd=root, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        self.assertEqual((root / "retry-budget.txt").read_text().strip(), "2")
        self.assertEqual(approved_retry_limit(root), 5)
        (root / "retry-budget.txt").write_text("9\n")
        git("add", "retry-budget.txt")
        git("commit", "--quiet", "-m", "second reviewed budget")
        git("tag", "--force", "reviewed-budget")
        (root / "retry-budget.txt").write_text("3\n")
        git("add", "retry-budget.txt")
        git("commit", "--quiet", "-m", "newer unapproved experiment")
        self.assertEqual(approved_retry_limit(root), 9)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
